name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix + resource domain (home rsrc.c, portrait-cache subsystem) + descriptor portrait_cache_count. 'count' correctly reflects the data type (a runtime counter). No Ghidra address residue; no domain ID to preserve.
purpose: Runtime counter: number of portraits currently resident in the portrait sprite cache (data_fd2_portrait_sprite_cache @ 0x53A61); range 0..40 (40 = cache structural capacity).
logic_summary: Zero at startup via CRT BSS-zero; that zero is the live 'cache empty / needs first-time alloc' signal inside fd2_load_portrait_to_cache. Read as a single dword: CMP [0x53BDF],0 first-init gate; signed loop bound for the cache-hit linear search over id_list[0..count-1]; IMUL count,0xc to index the frame-offset lookup table on append; post-increment (INC / MOV+LEA+MOV) on first-init and on cache-miss append. Reset to 0 (MOV [0x53BDF],0) by every cache-rebuild path before reloading FDICON.B24 portraits for the current menu party.
element_semantics: Single scalar: count of cached portraits (0..40). Parallel to data_fd2_resource_portrait_cache_id_list_base @ 0x53B17 (id_list[count] = next free slot's portrait id) and data_fd2_resource_portrait_cache_buffer_used @ 0x539EC (packed-sprite tail cursor).
comment_original_issue: src comment block (rsrc.c lines 797-820) was already accurate, precise, ASCII, with correct datatype reasoning (uint32/dword), range 0..40, the gate/bound/IMUL/increment access pattern, and reset-on-rebuild writers. No issue; kept verbatim.
notes: Ghidra plate was wrongly stored in PRE_COMMENT (data-plate convention requires PLATE_COMMENT) and contained two inaccuracies: it described the companion id_list @ 0x53B17 as 'parallel byte[40]' (disasm at 0x11129 shows dword stride: CMP ESI,dword ptr [EDX+0x53b17] with EDX=idx<<2) and listed only '5 sites in 2 functions' for writers. Verified via get_xrefs_to + disassemble_function (0x11090) + decompile of fd2_load_portrait_to_cache (0x11090), fd2_chapter_transition_menu (0x2cbb3), fd2_pin_required_char_to_party_slot1 (0x322d6): all 7 WRITE functions reset to 0 (engine init, chapter battle load, chapter transition menu, load-state-from-slot, class-promotion menu, recruitment/branch screen, pin-required-char); the sole increment/gate/bound reader is fd2_load_portrait_to_cache. Moved corrected content into PLATE_COMMENT (run_script_inline, PLATE_NOW_LEN=1492) and cleared PRE_COMMENT (PRE_NOW=null). src comment kept as-is; only the shard committed to git (no src edit needed).
